title: Triangle identities for the rational projective line
statement:
With $\eta$ and $\varepsilon$ as in
[det-prop-p1-adjunction-rational-unit-counit], for
$M\in\Loc(\Dbc(\mathbf P^1_Y,\Lambda))$ and $K\in\Loc(\Dbc(Y,\Lambda))$,

$$
\begin{aligned}
\varepsilon_{Rq_*M}\circ Rq_*(\eta_M)
&=Rq_*\bigl(1_M\otimes(\operatorname{Tr}_{p_1}\circ Rp_{1*}\delta_\Lambda)\bigr),\\
q^*(\varepsilon_K)(1)[2]\circ\eta_{q^*K(1)[2]}
&=1_{q^*K(1)[2]}\otimes(\operatorname{Tr}_{p_2}\circ Rp_{2*}\delta_\Lambda),
\end{aligned}
$$

and both right sides are identities. Consequently $(\eta,\varepsilon)$ is the
unit and counit of an adjunction $Rq_*\dashv q^*(1)[2]$ between
$\Loc(\Dbc(\mathbf P^1_Y,\Lambda))$ and $\Loc(\Dbc(Y,\Lambda))$, and
$q^!\simeq q^*(1)[2]$, with $q^!$ the right adjoint of
[sk-prop-sf-existence].

proof.text: Apply lem-rational-p1-kernel-contractions to the referenced family and the selected unitCounit pair. Its UnitCounitNormalized hypothesis is exactly the determining property returned by unitCounit_existsUnique. Unfold diagonalIntegralAction and diagonalIntegral at indices 0 and 1 and reassociate compositions to obtain the first two displayed equalities. The child uses precisely the ambient component formulas; no adjunction is assumed.

For each i, unfold diagonalIntegral and use the integration_i equation stored in Diagram. Whiskering the resulting identity, cancelling singleUnitIso and the right unitor, and applying Functor.map_id prove the third and fourth displayed conclusions. Full-subcategory hom extensionality then turns the two kernel calculations into both triangle identities.

Form Adjunction.CoreUnitCounit with the prescribed selected natural transformations and the componentwise triangle identities. Adjunction.mkOfUnitCounit gives the required adjunction, and its unit and counit are definitionally the specified transformations.

Identify the ctf and bc localizing ObjectProperty predicates by localizingClosure_ctf_equals_bc, for either E or Qbar_l. Use the trivial proper compactification (identity open embedding, q) and derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekId to identify its ambient lower shriek with Rq_*. The comparison from compactification_coherence_cocycle identifies any chosen compactification with this one. Cancel the fully faithful full-subcategory inclusion to identify the restricted left adjoints. Transport the given Brown adjunction by ofNatIsoLeft, and use rightAdjointUniq against the constructed adjunction. The equivalences induced by equality of the ObjectProperty predicates retain the ambient inclusion isomorphisms, yielding all three comparison isomorphisms.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q145-aa604e135 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: The mathematics is correct; one small repair. (1) The flagged batch-5 citation of lem-pd-module-ringed-topos-derived-comparison is acceptable. It is a generic comparison between module objects and ringed-topos sheaves of modules, covering the derived functors, tensor, adjunction and projection map. Neither the Poincaré duality assumption (isIso_poincareMap) nor the trace-formula assumption states it. Batch 5 already reaches it independently of this delivery, through det-thm-sf-pf-adic-projection (path from nt-target-weil-conjectures via sk-thm-sf-package, computed on the snapshot). nt-target-poincare-isiso is not reached from the batch-5 roots. The node is unsplit with proof_deps [], so citing it imports no step of either assumed proof. Its hypotheses hold here: characteristic p ≠ ℓ, separated finite-type k-schemes, and E or Q̄_ℓ as a commutative condensed ring. (2) Steps 1-7 follow the main-20261015 blueprint proof: first identity, second identity, integration, then uniqueness of the right adjoint via the trivial compactification. Base change is the canonical mate β from the unit-counit node, never a seeded theorem. Coefficients are always unbounded modules over the pulled-back condensed Λ on Loc(D_bc), identified with Loc(D_ctf) by det-def-localizing-closure-ctf-equals-bc(2). I recomputed both triangles. The first presentation of κ is R(b_M)∘π_q. Using t_1β̄ = L(t) (diagonal-tower-coefficients clause 3) and π-naturality, the first triangle reduces to R(1⊗t_1)∘Rπ_{p1}^{-1}. In the unit, the unit map a_M equals the diagonal projection π_Δ, because their transposes agree. In the second triangle the coherence node applies with (q,p_2,q,p_1), E = T_P, Q = K. The two T_W factors in step 3 differ by the swap on Λ(1)[2]⊗Λ(1)[2], which is the identity. Step 5 is diagonal-tower-trace(2) plus coefficients (1)-(2); step 6 (the Hom bijection) is elementary; step 7 transports Brown's adjoint along φ in the correct direction, using det-sf-comp-coherence-cocycle and det-sp-unique-right-adjoint. (3) Both new nodes are true and are not clauses of the item. In lem-sfb-ringed-kunneth-factorizations both composites have the transpose (A v_M∘θ)⊗B v_N. lem-sfb-ringed-projection-tensor-composition states the standard tensor and composition coherences, and its section clause follows from them with π_id = id. Tested on identity maps, zero objects and non-cartesian squares. Neither duplicates an existing node: lem-trf-relative-kunneth-counit, def-sfb-projection-formula and prop-sf-pf-coherence are in different settings. (4) FIX: removed three stmt_deps that the statement of lem-sfb-ringed-projection-tensor-composition never uses (def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate, def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-exchange-tensor-coherence); corrected file under fixes/dag/nodes/sec-six-functors-basics/.
